content: Inguc mime na honocmengka nu monic laliyeicne nganiiba. Hei, yowa esecne kpeng ucine ingucne yowa-malac monic edocnume ngageiba, yedi yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ga yawa ofenong. Yagolec lobeina ma pasi fikedaicte, yogo edalicgudacte.”

content: Hei, inguc mime iwahac Asudi nala bole bame nganibe honocmengka ngictaule ngiye-ngiye loicne iwa monicti yogolec feina ngiyewec.
Yele angoc yogo posa basufaleicne, yogo posa sasacne nga posa hunga, yeke ingucne. Ailu hulilic monic posa hedonggboli ingucne, yogodi ngictaule ngiye-ngiyewa lolickelu fawec.

Ailu ngictaule ngiye-ngiye ngiyeme ngictaule ngiye-ngiye gocne, dzalengineng 24, yenge ngictaule mac ngiye-ngiye yogo lolickelu ngiyecaigaing. Ngiye-ngiye yogolec feina damong 24 ingucti ngiyecaigaing. Damong yenge ngakpingineng kwalac-kwalac holelu hodocngineng feina ngictaule duu goldi baicne holelu ngiyecaigaing.
Inguc nganicebabe pilatac bame gbululung ucine sugucnehacti ngictaule ngiye-ngiyewacni fikewec. Ngictaule ngiye-ngiyele haicka hifa 7 lobecaigaing, yogo Wapongte asu 7.

Aime ngictaule ngiye-ngiyele haicka wiyac monic kiwec sugucne ingucne galasdi baicne, galas yogo wonongngine mikac nganiiba. Aime ngictaule ngiye-ngiyewa neboc nga neboc 4, iwa wiyac gaganginengkolec 4 yengi hewalingkelu domacaigaing. Yenge emengineng nga lobengineng sasawa yogo dongedi wakeyackeicne.

Wiyac gagaineholec molic-molic, yele ngani-nganiine laion ingucne. Aime yele lobeina, wiyac gagaineholec monic ye bulumaka ngicne tapiliineholec ingucne. Aime yele lobeina wiyac gagaineholec monic, ye haic-mesuine ngani-nganiine ngic ingucne. Aime moto-motoina wiyac gagaineholec monic, ye hikic sugucnedi filalangkecaigac, ingucne aiwec.

Wiyac gaganginengkolec 4 yenge filesoc filesoc kwenggelengngineng 6. Ailu socngineng sasawa yogo dongedi saweyackeicne. Ailu kwenggelengngineng bageina yogo inguchac dongeholec. Ailu yenge hadeng nga debocsoc ngiye-ngagec mikac yanguc milu gacaigaing,

content.text: Ye gawec nga gagac ailu gacgu kwesinowagac.”

content: Aime ngictaule mac ngiye-ngiyeina ngiyecaigac, ye gaga-sanang gaginowagac. Aime wiyac gaganginengkolec yenge yele wac bafelu alang bacnolu kwele-madic micaigaing. Inguc micaigaingka,

ye ngictaule ngiye-ngiyeina ngiyecaigac, ailu gaga-sanang gaginowagac, damong 24 yenge yele higewa ketadi holecaigaing. Holelu ye afeelu ngictaule duungineng bamoctolu ngictaule ngiye-ngiyeinele emeina wickebong wame yanguc migaing,

content.text: Gagi wiyac sasawa miyengka fikeyackelu gaganginengkolec fagaing.
Gageuc ngagelu inguc bafuwayackeingte, ga andoine. Ilec ailu wac feicne nga alang-baba ailu tapili sasawa badamecte.”

footnotes.text: Posa wacngineng yogo yanguc, yaspa, kanelian, nga emeral.
